credits.title: Hungry Ghost Festival
credits.overview: After inadvertently violating a sacred ancestral taboo during the Hungry Ghost Festival, an adopted young man and his friends must break a relentless supernatural curse before the spiritual gates close permanently.

credits.title: Agape: The Unconditional Love
credits.overview: A story about a silent, but deep struggle. About a caregiver who loves unconditionally, with a heart that never asks for something back.

credits.title: Arwah
credits.overview: Five siblings who have plans to go on vacation. However, on their journey, they experienced a serious accident which killed Sofi, their youngest sister. After Sofi's death, her four older siblings felt guilty until finally they felt terrorized by the incident.
